people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The king of Israel answered, “It is according to your saying, my lord, O king. I am yours, and all that I have.”
translations.bsb: And the king of Israel replied, “Just as you say, my lord the king: I am yours, along with all that I have.”
translations.kjv: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
translations.asv: And the king of Israel answered and said, It is according to thy saying, my lord, O king; I am thine, and all that I have.
